description: New 40-episode suite covering 12 fresh fact types across personal, work (project-state emphasis), and agentic (config emphasis) domains — no overlap with the original 21 fact types.
style: personal = friendly casual chat; work = professional but conversational, some Jira/PR references; agentic = technical with tool-output blocks, kubectl/curl/config snippets
